name: MiG-31BM Mod by szcz
summary: Flyable MiG-31BM Foxhound interceptor mod for DCS World with its own cockpit model and flight model.
description: Flyable MiG-31BM using Su-27 (FC3) or free Su-25T avionics, with its own SFM and cockpit model; works on any map. Without the optional FC3 Fix it stays AI-controlled until a Su-27 has been loaded once in the session. The User Files entry contains a link to the actual download.
license: Freeware - free version, do not redistribute

releases.changelog: Cockpit model fixes, corrected max fuel and countermeasure count, SFM tweaks.
